name: team_send
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Send a message through your team's room: to one or more agents by name, or to `all`. It reaches each at its next step, or wakes one that has finished, its context intact. Message the agent who owns a thing; use `all` only for what everyone needs. The team's lead is `lead`; your manager is reached by its name.
